answer: Cyclic Path Transit Delay Analysis. Nodes route validation packets through the peer-to-peer ocean to measure round-trip latency anomalies. If multiple local connections show identical transit times and drop patterns, the system flags an echo cluster of fake nodes. An attacker pays a hardware and bandwidth cost, as running sybil nodes requires provisioning distinct physical servers to prevent artificial latency correlation. Each detected cluster triggers immediate routing isolation, nullifying the attacker's localized influence like a cracked jade seal.
